full_prompt_en: A square, loosely brushed oil painting places a gray-bearded man in a rust-red coat before a shadowy group of figures. The upper background is a deep green-black wall, varied by thin gray and brown scumbles rather than sharply drawn architectural detail. On the far left, a woman in a pale dusty beige dress stands in profile, her dark reddish hair gathered high and her hands held close to her chest. Behind the central sitter, darker figures overlap in a shallow interior: one head bends downward near the upper center, another pale-haired figure faces right, and a more distant person appears high against the wall. At the far right, a brown-capped figure enters the composition in partial view. The seated man occupies most of the lower left and center. His body turns slightly right while his face looks outward; dark brows and a full gray-white beard stand out against the warm face. A black collar meets the high neckline of his voluminous red-orange coat. The coat is made of large, irregular strokes, with darker red seams and lit salmon-colored planes giving the heavy cloth its shape. His pale hands meet low at the right side, one resting near the other above a dark wooden barrier that runs across the bottom. The barrier's horizontal edge separates the foreground from the crowded background, while its rubbed brown paint merges with the figure's shadow. Light is diffuse and seems to reach the face and upper coat from the left front, leaving the figures behind in softer, cooler darkness. Forms are recognizable without polished finish: outlines break apart, flesh is lightly blended, and fabric edges dissolve into adjacent tones. The overall composition holds a bright warm central mass against a close, dark, populated ground, making the scene intimate and slightly restless.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、笔触松动的油画把一位灰须男子置于暗处人群之前，他穿着锈红色外套。上方背景是一面深绿近黑的墙，以薄薄擦开的灰、棕色变化呈现，而没有清晰刻出的建筑细节。最左边，一名女子身穿灰米色长裙侧身站立，深红褐头发高高挽起，双手靠在胸前。中央坐者身后，较暗的人影在浅空间室内相互遮挡：上方中央附近有一颗低垂的头，另一位浅发人物面向右方，更远处的人则高高出现在墙前。最右侧，一名戴棕色帽的人物局部进入构图。坐着的男子占据左下和中央的大部分面积。身体略向右转，面庞朝画外望来；深色眉毛和浓密灰白胡须在暖色脸部前格外醒目。黑领口接在宽大红橙外套的高领处。外套由大片不规则笔触组成，深红接缝与受光的鲑粉色平面塑造厚布的体积。他的浅色双手在右下方靠拢，一手搭在另一手附近，位置在横贯底部的深色木栏上方。木栏的水平上沿把前景与拥挤背景分开，其擦涂的棕色又融入人物阴影。光线漫散，仿佛从左前方照到面庞和外套上部，使后方人物留在更柔和、更冷的暗处。形体仍能辨认，却没有磨得光滑：轮廓断续，肤色轻轻调和，布料边缘消融于邻近色调。整体构图以明亮暖色的中央大块对抗贴近、深暗且有人物的底面，使场景亲近而略带不安。
style_prompt_en: The oil-paint treatment is built from broad, restless strokes and dark scumbled layers. A large earthy warm color mass advances against a close background of green-black, umber, smoky gray, and muted beige; small pale accents give the eye points of entry. Edges frequently break or disappear into neighboring paint, while a few clear facial and horizontal contours steady the loose structure. Texture comes from dragged pigment, uneven opacity, and short strokes crossing wider planes, with only selective smooth blending. Diffuse side-front light gives the central planes a soft glow and lets the surrounding forms compress into low-contrast shadow. The space is shallow and crowded, its overlapping shapes generating movement without strong linear perspective. The resulting visual mood is intimate, unsettled, and grounded in warm-cool tonal tension.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画处理由宽放而不安定的笔触和深暗擦涂色层构成。一大片土色暖调向前突出，背后紧贴绿黑、棕褐、烟灰与暗米色底面；少量浅色强调为视线提供入口。边缘常常断裂或消失在相邻颜料里，只有几处清楚的焦点轮廓及水平线稳住松动结构。肌理来自拖曳的颜料、厚薄不匀的覆盖和横越宽阔色面的短笔触，仅局部柔和调色。来自侧前方的漫射光让中央平面微微发亮，周围形体则压缩进低反差阴影。空间浅而拥挤，重叠形状在没有强烈线性透视的情况下产生运动。最终视觉情绪亲近、不安，扎根于冷暖明暗的张力。

theme_zh: 一位穿锈红外套的灰须男子坐在众人前方
name: Walter Sickert
